integrity: The arbitrary-order statement is proved analytically from the exact multiset distance profile induced by pure versus mixed partition blocks. The initiating full text and targeted semantic searches were inspected for implication and overlap. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected noncomplete complete multipartite graphs. The finite checker covers total order at most 7 and is a stress test only. The complete-graph case is already known from the initiating paper and is explicitly excluded from the originality-bearing claim.
title: Noncomplete complete multipartite graphs have infinite multiset partition dimension
